name: Prior Capsule — typed wrapper for chuck-prior-capsule.mjs
description: Typed surface for the chuck-prior-capsule generator. Single action 'build' invokes chuck-prior-capsule.mjs (1253 LOC source-reader + renderer) as a subprocess and parses the receipt JSON. Used by skill-prior-compaction's approve action and skill-docket-executor. Full TS source-port deferred until openclaw cron/daemon support is in.

scriptPath.label: chuck-prior-capsule.mjs path
scriptPath.help: Path to the canonical .mjs implementation. Defaults to the repo's extensions/memory-graph/scripts/chuck-prior-capsule.mjs.
